title: Matrix-Level Cauchy Interlacing from the Compression Identity

problemStatement.plain: The parent gallery entry proves the geometric fact that orthogonally compressing a linear map to the coordinate hyperplane $H = e_j^{\perp}$ yields exactly the principal submatrix of $A$ with row and column $j$ deleted. This problem closes the loop: package that identity into the classical matrix statement that the eigenvalues of the deleted-row-and-column principal submatrix interlace the eigenvalues of $A$.

currentState.focus: Formalized the isometric-conjugation invariance corollary (eigenvalues_isometryConj); remaining work is the explicit isometry and the matrix-level assembly.
currentState.nextAction: Build isometry phi from hyperplaneBasis, prove compress equals phi-conjugated toEuclideanLin of the principal submatrix, then combine eigenvalues_isometryConj with cauchy_interlacing_compression.

knowledge.progressSummary: PROGRESS: formalized eigenvalues_isometryConj (unitary conjugation invariance of the sorted spectrum), the crux lemma flagged as future work by the keystone (#25063), principal-submatrix identification (#27917) and bridge (#27958). Build-pending: Docker containerd and Aristotle both down.
builtItems: eigenvalues_isometryConj in proofs/Proofs/CauchyInterlacingIsometryConj.lean: for self-adjoint S,T intertwined by a linear isometry equiv e (S(e x)=e(T x)), hS.eigenvalues = hT.eigenvalues. Proved as a direct specialization of the parent eigenvalues_eq_of_eigenbasis using the transported basis (eigenvectorBasis).map e.
insights: The parent entry #27958 only STATES the isometric-conjugation corollary in its docstring; it was never formalized. eigenvalues_isometryConj now closes that gap in about 15 lines.

Mechanism: OrthonormalBasis.map_apply gives (b.map e) i = e (b i); then S(e(b i)) = e(T(b i)) = e(f i . b i) = f i . e(b i) makes the transported basis an S-eigenbasis with the SAME antitone eigenvalue tuple, so the bridge lemma forces equality of sorted spectra.

The full matrix assembly needs three glued pieces, all present in-repo: cauchy_interlacing_compression (#25063), compress_inner_eq_principalSubmatrix (#27917), and eigenvalues_isometryConj (new). Only the isometry construction remains.
mathlibGaps: Mathlib lacks sorted-spectrum invariance under unitary/isometric conjugation for LinearMap.IsSymmetric.eigenvalues; now proven locally as eigenvalues_isometryConj.
nextSteps: Construct the isometry phi from EuclideanSpace over Fin n to the coordinate hyperplane via Orthonormal.toOrthonormalBasis on hyperplaneBasis j and OrthonormalBasis.repr.symm.

Prove the compression equals phi-conjugated toEuclideanLin of the principal submatrix on the standard basis by comparing inner products against hyperplaneBasis j i' (both equal the submatrix entry) using OrthonormalBasis.repr injectivity.
Apply eigenvalues_isometryConj with e := phi-inverse, then substitute into cauchy_interlacing_compression to obtain the matrix-level interlacing.
BUILD-VERIFY eigenvalues_isometryConj once Docker containerd recovers (meta.db I/O error currently blocks all builds; Aristotle returns 404).
